title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Company Description

Scandinavian Capital Markets is a foreign currency broker based in Stockholm with a remote workforce. We are building the next generation of currency trading technology and products, and we are looking for someone who can work independently and think outside the box. If you are someone who excels at mobile technologies, but also wants to have a voice in high-level decisions such as architecture and product, we want to meet you!


Role Description

We are looking for a sharp, independent engineer to join our team as a Fullstack Mobile Developer. You will work directly with our core team to build, optimize, and scale the mobile applications driving our product. This is a fully remote position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Design and build robust backend APIs (e.g., Node.js, TypeScript, or Python) to support real-time mobile features.
  • Implement secure, seamless user interfaces (UI/UX) for complex financial dashboards and trading screens.
  • Handle real-time market data streams by integrating WebSockets and optimizing app state management.


Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript. (must)
  • Solid backend experience (Node.js, Python, or similar) and familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Bonus: Experience with financial markets, fintech apps, or secure payment gateways.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
***Technical Business Analyst – 6 months+ - Brazil (Remote)***



We are currently supporting an international client who is looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst to join their team working on manufacturing and production IT systems.


This role acts as the key interface between business stakeholders and IT development teams , supporting the deployment, analysis, and improvement of systems such as ERP production

modules, MES, TPS, and SAP .



▶️ Start: ASAP

Duration: 6 months+

Location: Brazil - Remote

Language: English and Portuguese language skills



Key Responsibilities:


• Act as the interface between business users and development teams

• Support the analysis and improvement of manufacturing processes and systems

• Assist with system deployments, go-live, and user support

• Analyse incidents and change requests and assess their impact

• Translate business needs into functional requirements or user stories

• Support Agile delivery and user acceptance testing (UAT)



Key Requirements:


• Experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Functional Consultant

• Experience with manufacturing or production IT systems

• Knowledge of systems such as ERP (production modules), MES, SCM, WMS, or traceability solutions

• Experience working with business stakeholders and technical teams

• Experience in industrial environments (manufacturing, automotive, pharma, etc.)


Nice to have:


• SQL knowledge

• Experience within industrial sectors such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace, food production, or manufacturing

title: Sap MDK Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP MDK Consultant

Location : Brazil (Remote)

Job Responsibilities

· Develop and enhance SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK) applications.

· Participate in SAP Asset Manager implementations, including full lifecycle projects.

· Enhance and extend the standard functionality of SAP Asset Manager.

· Create and debug MDK Branded Clients for Android and iOS platforms.

· Configure and support the Mobile Application Integration Framework (SAP Syclo Framework).

· Utilize SAP Gateway Tracing and Error Logs for issue analysis and resolution.

· Work extensively with OData Services for mobile application integration.

· Support and execute SAP Asset Manager upgrade activities.

· Apply SAP ABAP debugging knowledge when required (added advantage).

· Leverage knowledge of SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) / Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) processes (plus).

· Enforce application development Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with the development team.

· Ensure adherence to architecture standards and principles throughout the development lifecycle.

· Coordinate and manage MDK-related issues during Unit Testing and Integration Testing phases.

Required Skills & Qualifications

· 4+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Mobile Development Kit (MDK) application development.

· Strong SAP mobility experience, with at least one full lifecycle implementation in Asset Management mobility.

· Experience configuring and deploying mobile applications via SAP BTP Mobile Services.

· Proven implementation and enhancement experience in SAP Asset Manager.

· Strong integration expertise using OData services, including online and offline synchronization.

· Solid programming skills in JavaScript for MDK rule development and customization.

· Backend integration experience with SAP S/4HANA.

· Knowledge of offline enablement, synchronization, security (OAuth/SAML), and performance optimization.

· Experience working with legacy mobility solutions such as SAP Syclo

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years’ experience in an administrative, coordinator, client facing or customer service role
  • Ability to complete tasks with accuracy and speed
  • Eagerness to learn and the bravery to work through stages of ambiguity
  • Strong ability to handle confidential information with discretion and maturity
  • Superior organizational skills, detail-orientation, and the ability to prioritize workload independently
  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic environment
  • Excellent technology skills, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Experience with Workday and Jobvite is preferred Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A collaborative mindset, the individual will be a team player, proactive and results driven

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
The Recruiting Coordinator plays a critical role within the Talent Acquisition team at the client and is the convergence of all recruitment activity across the organization. This position is responsible for coordinating the logistics and execution of all recruitment activities at the client.


The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. The RC plays a key role in the talent acquisition team’s mission to ensure every candidate's experience in the job search process with the client is positive and meaningful.


Essential Skills Attention to detail: The RC needs to possess a strong eye for detail. The ideal candidate will create and own complex interview schedules that may include multiple locations, time zones and social mediums for conducting the interview (virtual and in-person).

It is crucial that the RC pays close attention to arrangements that often change, frequently at the last minute. In addition, the RC will draft important documentation (weekly reports, new hire paperwork, offer letters, proposals etc.) that have no margin for error.


Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. This position requires sound business judgment and maturity, and the ability to exercise appropriate discretion. The successful candidate will have a mature, professional, and polished demeanor. The RC will hold in the utmost confidence the details of every search process and protect the privacy of candidate personal data.


Intellectual Curiosity & Interest in Recruiting: The individual will have an active curiosity in recruiting, working with the broader talent acquisition team to assist in research, sourcing, candidate development, and a variety of talent acquisition related projects. In this regard, the CSS needs to demonstrate flexibility and a proactive demeanor


Responsibilities:

  • Provide recruitment support for a team of LoB recruiters including scheduling, coordinating, and facilitating in-person, phone, and video conference interviews
  • Create, collect, and compile feedback and manage briefing documents
  • Ensure data integrity and update candidate records in the applicant tracking system and HRIS as needed, including entering NDA documentation and relevant interview details
  • Manage logistics for the recruiting process, including travel arrangement, expense reimbursements, generating offer letters and ensuring background checks are 100% completed
  • Ensure every candidate experience working with the client is positive and leaves them feeling like they want to work here
  • Being the eyes and ears of the team, having the confidence to raise questions and make suggestions
  • Project based work across recruitment- we are enthusiastic about having a team member who has a growth mindset and is passionate about continuing to learn and evolve!

title: Web Designer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

*Experience writing and manipulating HTML

* Proficient in English, attentive to industry standards, and equipped with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* Proficient with Figma for prototyping, sharing/testing designs

* Experience with utilizing a Design System

* Experience with front-end testing

*Experience working within a CMS to build webpages with components


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

*Experience in Adobe Creative suite (Photoshop)

* Experience contributing to a Design System

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Manager


Job Description

A BioTech client is seeking a Web Designer to join their team remotely in Brazil. This person will:

* Facilitate front-end content and code updates to the marketing website within Adobe Experience Manager

* Utilize brand guidelines and design system insights to build out new pages and experiences using existing code

* Collaborate closely with UX team to prototype intuitive experiences

* Source and manipulate imagery to create web-formatted graphics & banners

* Design layouts and templates for global solutions that focus on user experience

* Present design solutions to stakeholders and leadership

* Contribute to collaborative design sessions

* Support cross-browser testing at multiple stages of a project

* Evolve and build out the marketing site component and pattern libraries

** This role can pay up to $3,400 USD monthly

title: Editor de Vídeo [Araújo & Melchert]
description:
Informações Gerais:

Empresa:  Araújo & Melchert;

Modalidade:  Remoto;

Horário:  Segunda à sexta-feira em horário comercial;

Tipo de Vaga:  CLT.

Remuneração:  R$ 3.670,88 + benefícios


Sobre a oportunidade:

Na Araújo & Melchert Advogados, buscamos um Editor de Vídeo apaixonado por criar narrativas impactantes que ajudem a fortalecer a presença digital da nossa marca. Nesta função, você terá a oportunidade de traduzir estratégias de marketing em conteúdo relevante, contribuindo diretamente para a construção de relacionamentos sólidos com nossos clientes e aumentando nossa visibilidade no mercado jurídico.


Como Analista de Marketing de conteúdo você terá como atividades:

  • Escrever, com o apoio de I.A., roteiros de vídeos curtos (até 90 segundos), alinhados à estratégia de conteúdo e objetivos do negócio;
  • Editar vídeos no CapCut, garantindo padrão visual, dinamismo e adequação à identidade da marca;
  • Agendar vídeos no MLabs, organizando a distribuição conforme o calendário editorial;
  • Realizar acompanhamento de resultados (views, engajamento, comentários e métricas relevantes), contribuindo com insights para otimização contínua do conteúdo.
Requisitos

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar com ferramentas de edição como CapCut;
  • Ter experiência atuando como Analista de MKT, Social Media ou áreas relacionadas ao MKT, editor de vídeo;
  • Capacidade de criar roteiros de conteúdo, especialmente para vídeos curtos;
  • Experiência em responder comentários e interagir com o público (community management);
  • Capacidade de edição de conteúdo usando ferramentas como Canva;
  • Precisa possuir os equipamentos de trabalho como: Notebook, tela auxiliar, fone e ambiente tranquilo e adequado;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA para automatizar e melhorar as rotinas da área.


Você irá se diferenciar se possuir:

  • Experiência com automações.
  • Ter conhecimento em tráfego pago.
  • Capacidade de edição de conteúdo usando Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects.
  • Certificação em Inbound Marketing ou Marketing Digital.
  • Formação em Comunicação, Marketing ou áreas afins.
  • Graduação em direito.



Requisitos Comportamentais:

  • Comprometimento com a qualidade, entrega e precisão do conteúdo produzido;
  • Proatividade na busca por novas ideias e soluções criativas;
  • Ter atenção a detalhes para a edição de conteúdo para identificar estratégias e maior conversão dos vídeos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar efetivamente com diferentes áreas;
  • Abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender com críticas construtivas.
  • Gostar de trabalhar com planejamento;
  • Ótima comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Empatia ao lidar com clientes e comunidade online.
Benefícios

O que te entregamos?

  • Vale-alimentação: R$ 734,18;
  • Cesta básica: R$ 130,00;
  • Plano educacional: R$ 550,63;
  • Reembolso home office: R$ 917,72 por mês;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco Nacional (sem coparticipação) para titular + 1 dependente: R$ 1.000,00;
  • 14º salário (prêmio anual por resultado).


As etapas do processo serão:

  • Triagem dos(as) candidatos(as);
  • Preenchimento de formulário técnico e autoentrevista;
  • Entrevista com o RH e aplicação de ferramenta de autoconhecimento;
  • Entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) e simulação prática.
  • Fez sentido para você? Então inscreva-se  para nos conhecermos melhor.

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

  • Engage with clients to understand their business processes and requirements.

  • Prepare and present project documentation and reports to stakeholders.

  • Strong expertise in SAP S/4 HANA Rise with SAP PCA.

  • Experience with SAP Fiori and SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Knowledge of industry specific SAP solutions.
  • Project management experience in SAP projects.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Relevant SAP certifications, particularly in S/4 HANA and PCA.
  • Proven track record of successful SAP project implementations.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:

This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders.   • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


*Validade do processo seletivo: 06 meses

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
At Wisevu™ and our sister brands Homevu™ and CharityMarketing.com, we’ve been driving digital marketing success for over 17 years, specializing in SEO, digital PR, AI, content marketing, and web development for healthcare, home services, and charity clients in the United States and Canada.


What Will You Do?

  • This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Media Buyer.
  • Plan, launch, and manage high-ROAS paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant platforms.
  • Write compelling Ads sales copy that drives clicks and conversions.
  • Conduct A/B testing on ad creatives and landing pages to continuously improve performance.
  • Implement and test conversion tracking & analyze campaign performance using analytics tools.
  • Collaborate with the Paid Media Manager and cross-functional teams to create high-performing campaigns.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
  • Professional English fluency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Work experience in a digital marketing (advertising) agency.
  • Strong marketing knowledge and ability to write persuasive sales copy.


Benefits:

  • Fully remote work.
  • Competitive salary, which will be negotiated during the interview based on competencies, skills, and experience.
  • Annual salary review.
  • Premium training programs and access to an internal mentorship team with vast experience in digital marketing.
  • Professional equipment budget.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools.
  • Long-term and stable working relationship in a company thats been growing since 2008.


We’re excited to see your work and hear your ideas, and work on exciting projects together. 


We kindly ask that you provide us with your resume in English.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps

PJ

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About IDP

At International Digital Partners (IDP) , we connect top global talent with fast-growing, innovative companies. We are a fully remote, multicultural team focused on delivering real value to our clients through technology, consulting, and digital execution. Our mission is to build world-class technical teams, and that’s where you come in.


About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Recruiter , highly experienced, self-driven, and multilingual, to join our international Talent Acquisition team. This is a key role in helping us scale technical teams across the U.S., Latin America, and Europe. You'll own full-cycle recruitment for high-demand technical roles.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment life cycle for technical roles: intake, sourcing, interviewing, coordinating, and offer negotiation;
  • Screen and assess candidates, both on soft skills and basic technical fit;
  • Source talent proactively via LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and other sourcing platforms;
  • Maintain clear, professional communication in English and Spanish.
  • Build and nurture a pipeline of high-quality candidates across multiple regions and time zones;
  • Ensure a seamless, positive candidate experience from first contact to onboarding;
  • Contribute to process improvement and employer branding initiatives.


Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruiting, with proven success in international or remote hiring;
  • Solid understanding of tech stacks, tools, and roles (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps, Data, QA);
  • Fluency (B2) in English is a must; Fluency in Spanish is highly preferred but not required
  • Experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Manatal, Greenhouse, Bullhorn) and sourcing tools like LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment;
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with a solution-oriented mindset.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Background in tech consulting or staffing;
  • Experience hiring across LATAM, U.S., and Europe;
  • Knowledge of international hiring models (contracting, nearshoring, etc.);
  • Familiarity with Agile environments and distributed tech teams.


What We Offer

  • Fully remote, international working environment
  • Supportive, multicultural team and collaborative culture
  • Access to innovative global projects with high impact
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

title: Analista de Processos de Negócio - Trabalho Remoto
description:
Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev® é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.


Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.


Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.


Analista de Processos de Negócio na BairesDev


Como Analista de Processos de Negócio na BairesDev, você estabelecerá a conexão entre as necessidades de negócios e soluções técnicas. Você coletará e analisará requisitos, documentará processos de negócios e colaborará com equipes multifuncionais para implementar sistemas que melhorem a eficiência operacional. Seu papel será crucial para garantir que as soluções tecnológicas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócios e entreguem valor mensurável.


O que você fará:


- Analisar processos e fluxos de trabalho de negócios para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização.

- Coletar, documentar e traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações funcionais para equipes de desenvolvimento.

- Colaborar com stakeholders para entender suas necessidades e garantir que as soluções atendam aos objetivos de negócios.

- Criar documentação detalhada, incluindo mapas de processos, casos de uso e histórias de usuário.

- Apoiar a testagem e implementação de novos sistemas e melhorias em soluções existentes.

- Atuar como intermediário entre usuários de negócios e equipes técnicas durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.



O que estamos procurando:


- 3+ anos de experiência em análise de negócios ou campo relacionado.

- Experiência com técnicas de coleta e documentação de requisitos.

- Conhecimento de modelagem e mapeamento de processos de negócios.

- Familiaridade com metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Waterfall).

- Capacidade de entender e documentar processos de negócios complexos.

- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico.

- Inglês avançado.



Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:


- Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

- Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.


Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description:
Localização


Remoto (Brasil) – com interação direta com clientes corporativos no Brasil e América Latina.


Sobre a ORAEX

A ORAEX é uma consultoria de tecnologia especializada em:

  • Cloud
  • DevOps
  • Databases
  • Observability
  • Reliability Engineering


Atuamos com grandes empresas ajudando a construir ambientes seguros, resilientes e escaláveis .

Estamos expandindo nossa atuação e precisamos estruturar melhor e de maneira estratégica a linha de Cybersecurity , incluindo:


  • SOC (Security Operations Center)
  • Vulnerability Management
  • Patch Management
  • Application Security (AppSec)
  • Security Monitoring
  • DevSecOps


Buscamos um Head of Cybersecurity para estruturar e liderar essa nova frente.


O desafio

Você será responsável por criar e liderar a prática de segurança da ORAEX , estruturando ofertas, liderando projetos e apoiando o time comercial na venda das soluções.

Essa posição exige perfil técnico profundo, visão estratégica e capacidade comercial .

title: Engenheiro Civil - Gestor de Obra
description:
Perfil Profissional

O candidato deve possuir perfil de liderança com foco em resultados e organização. É necessária proatividade, autoconfiança e ética, além de habilidades de negociação e persuasão para a gestão de pessoal, equipamentos e cumprimento de prazos.


Atividades e Responsabilidades

•Supervisão técnica de unidades, contratos e projetos sob sua responsabilidade.

•Planejamento de obras, controle de cronogramas e execução.

•Realização de Boletins de Medição de Obras e análise de resultados.

•Orçamentação de atividades/obras e análise de documentação técnica.

•Gestão de custos de obra vs. faturamentos e controle de despesas.

•Autorização de compra de materiais e requisição/desmobilização de equipamentos.

•Monitoramento técnico com proposição de ajustes em projetos para otimização de custos e zelo patrimonial.

•Domínio de rotinas administrativas pertinentes à função.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

•Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Civil com CREA ativo.

•Experiência: Atuação em obras públicas, preferencialmente com órgãos como DNIT, DER/ SEINFRA.

•Conhecimentos: em Terraplenagem, Pavimentação Betuminosa e Drenagens.

•Domínio: Excel avançado.

•Habilitação: CNH vigente.

•Mobilidade: Disponibilidade total para atuação em várias regiões, nomeadamente Norte e Sudeste.


Diferenciais

•Domínio dos softwares Sienge e Orçafascio.

Condições do Contrato

•Contratação PJ.


Interessados devem encaminhar o currículo para os e-mails:

e

title: B2B - PARTNER COMERCIAL
description:
Tem perfil hunter, busca novos horizontes na sua carreira e quer potencializar sua rede de contatos?

Então venha trabalhar no Grupo AG Capital e faça parte do modelo de atuação que está revolucionando o mercado tributário brasileiro - e moldando a carreira de centenas de executivos e empreendedores.


Quem somos

O Grupo AG Capital possui uma sólida trajetória de resultados em compliance tributário. Listada entre as empresas que mais cresceram no Brasil em 2022 e 2023 (Rankings Deloitte e Revista Exame, PWC e BTG Pactual).


Atuação com tecnologia tributária especializada, com mais de 13 mil clientes (sendo 15% das empresas listadas na B3) e mais de R$ 8 BI recuperados.


Empresas do Grupo AG Capital:

AG: Primeira TaxTech do Brasil e maior especialista no setor previdenciário desde 2010.

AG Tax: Operação especializada e com base tecnológica focada na recuperação de tributos diretos e indiretos.

Agnes: O primeiro monitor tributário de folha de pagamento e SST do Brasil. Tecnologia proprietária e pioneira a nível global.


Quem estamos buscando:

Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.

B2B Sales Partners do Grupo AG Capital contam com amplo treinamento sobre mercado e soluções, e nas reuniões com clientes é acompanhado do seu gestor comercial e profissionais da equipe técnica - com ampla estrutura tecnológica e time de suporte.


Desafios da posição

1. Desenvolvimento de novos negócios

2. Relacionamento com clientes

3. Networking qualificado

4. Estratégia de venda consultiva

5. Alianças estratégicas com rede de contatos

6. Desenvolvimento de parcerias

7. Identificação de oportunidades de negócio


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Fomentar e gerenciar sua carteira de empresas para fornecer soluções de produtos e desenvolver novos negócios (Empresas Lucro Presumido e Real);
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes. Fornecemos todo o suporte comercial para concretização do negócio com equipe técnica alocada e ferramentas tecnológicas;
  • Vontade de crescer e gerar resultados, com resiliência para prospectar sempre e buscar novas oportunidades;
  • Trajetória de sucesso na gestão de clientes;
  • Familiaridade com as métricas de desempenho de vendas;
  • Habilidades de apresentação e comunicação e postura corporativa profissional.


Principais perfis Business Partners (palavras-chave)

Gerentes Bancos, Gerente PJ, Gerente Regional. Parceiro de Negócios, Business Partner, Consultor Empresarial, Consultor RH, Representante Comercial com Carteira (PJ). Gerente Empresas, Gerente Plataformas, Contabilidade, FOPAG. Advogado. Consultor Tributário. Executivo Comercial. Contador.


Bacharelado nas áreas de RH, Marketing, Comercial, Economia, Administração, Direito, Finanças e correlacionados;


Remuneração agressiva acima do mercado.

title: Support Engineer (CMS)
description:
We are looking for a Support Engineer with a development background to help maintain, troubleshoot, and customize our CMS platforms and related systems.

This role sits at the intersection of technical support, system administration, and light development . You will focus on resolving technical issues, customizing existing functionality, supporting integrations, and helping internal teams and clients get the most out of the platform .

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating problems, working closely with users, and improving systems through configuration and small code changes . You should be comfortable reading and modifying code, analyzing database issues, and collaborating with different teams to deliver practical solutions.



Responsibilities

  • Provide tier 2/3 technical support for CMS-related issues and system integrations.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical problems reported by internal teams or clients.
  • Customize and configure CMS modules, workflows, and templates based on requirements.
  • Support data migrations and data integrity , including church data in Rock RMS.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand issues and propose technical solutions.
  • Maintain and optimize SQL queries and database structures when needed.
  • Assist with integrations between systems using REST APIs.
  • Write and maintain code changes in Liquid scripting language.
  • Document solutions, processes, and recurring issues to improve internal knowledge sharing.
  • Contribute to improving system reliability and support workflows.



Technology Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience working with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS .
  • Experience with C# Development.
  • SQL knowledge including querying, debugging, and data manipulation.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms such as Rock RMS, WordPress, Drupal, Sitecore, or similar.
  • Experience troubleshooting system issues and working with REST APIs .
  • Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience with workflow automation or templating engines (Lava/Liquid) is a plus.
  • Experience with Rock RMS Block development is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and curiosity to investigate technical issues.
  • Comfortable working with both technical systems and non-technical users .
  • Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and clear way.
  • Detail-oriented when working with data and system configurations.
  • Able to work independently and prioritize support requests.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to work across teams.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
Home Office | Belo Horizonte - MG


A EVO! não é mais uma plataforma.

Somos um marketplace logístico em escala nacional , conectando transportadoras e embarcadores todos os dias, movimentando milhares de veículos e dados em tempo real.


Estamos em crescimento acelerado e buscamos um(a) Analista de Sucesso – Transportadoras com perfil estratégico, analítico e protagonista .

Aqui, Customer Success não é suporte .

É relacionamento, performance, decisão e evolução operacional.

Se você gosta de conversar com clientes, analisar dados e assumir responsabilidade real sobre resultados, siga lendo.

Sua missão

Garantir que as transportadoras da rede EVO!:

  • entrem bem na plataforma
  • operem com eficiência
  • evoluam sua performance
  • cresçam junto com a EVO!

Você será o ponto de referência estratégico da transportadora dentro da plataforma.

O que você vai fazer na prática

  • Conduzir onboarding estratégico de novas transportadoras
  • Acompanhar de perto as operações
  • Monitorar engajamento, uso da plataforma e indicadores operacionais
  • Analisar dados e apoiar a tomada de decisão das transportadoras
  • Identificar riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria
  • Trabalhar com Excel no dia a dia (análises, controles e relatórios)
  • Traduzir dores reais em insights para Produto, Operações e Liderança
  • Atuar com autonomia sobre sua carteira de transportadoras
company: EVO! Tecnologia para Transporte de Veículos

title: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript) – Remote (Brazil)
description:
Position: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Job Type: Contract


About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript , along with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling .

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions that support business and analytics needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines .
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and system integrations .
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability .
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment .
  • Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese .

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions .
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development .
  • Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance .

title: SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil – Remote

Support Hours: EST Business Hours, with flexibility during month-end close and critical incidents

Languages: Fluent Portuguese and English (written and spoken)

Role Summary


We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant to provide L2 and L3 application support for Finance processes, with a strong focus on FI modules .

This role involves production support, incident and problem management, minor enhancements, and close collaboration with business stakeholders , particularly during month-end close activities , where CO and Material Ledger support is critical.

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, structured problem-solving, clear communication, and operational rigor in a run-and-maintain AMS environment .


Key Responsibilities

AMS Production Support (L2 / L3)

  • Provide L2/L3 functional support for SAP S/4HANA Finance processes, including incident, problem, and service request management .
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and implement permanent corrective actions .
  • Ensure adherence to SLA/OLA targets and operational KPIs.
  • Manage critical finance incidents , coordinating with technical teams and delivering timely stakeholder updates.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close , including extended support when required.

Functional Scope – FI / CO


Strong hands-on experience supporting:

FI Modules

  • FI-GL (General Ledger)
  • FI-AP (Accounts Payable)
  • FI-AR (Accounts Receivable)
  • FI-AA (Asset Accounting)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Brazil Localization (taxes, legal reporting, and country-specific requirements)

CO Modules (primarily during month-end close)

  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Period-end allocations and settlements


Additional requirements:

  • Strong understanding of FI-MM and FI-SD integrations , particularly finance postings originating from logistics processes .

Enhancements & Change Support

  • Deliver minor enhancements and configuration adjustments within the AMS scope.
  • Prepare functional specifications , test cases, and support UAT activities .
  • Participate in change and release management processes .
  • Maintain high-quality functional and operational documentation .


Behavioral Expectations

Accountability

  • Takes end-to-end ownership of issues until resolution.

Communication

  • Demonstrates clear, concise, and proactive communication with business and IT stakeholders.

Rigor & Discipline

  • Applies structured analysis, strong attention to detail, and maintains audit-ready documentation.

Collaboration

  • Works effectively across teams, vendors, and time zones.

Customer Focus

  • Understands business impact and prioritizes tasks accordingly.


Experience & Qualifications

  • 7–10 years of relevant SAP FICO experience .
  • Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA AMS Production Support environments.
  • Solid CO knowledge , particularly related to month-end close and Material Ledger activities .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Designer Gráfico Pleno
description:
Somos a Alvorada, uma agência especializada em comunicação para o agronegócio e estamos em busca de um Designer Gráfico Pleno para fortalecer nosso time criativo.


Procuramos alguém que já tenha alguma experiência na área, bom senso estético e organização para transformar ideias e informações em peças visuais claras, bonitas e eficientes. Aqui você vai trabalhar com marcas do agronegócio, pecuária, genética, tecnologia e demais empresas do campo, ajudando a comunicar projetos, campanhas e posicionamento de marca.


O que você vai fazer

  • Criar peças para redes sociais, campanhas e anúncios
  • Desenvolver materiais institucionais, apresentações e catálogos
  • Adaptar artes para diferentes formatos e plataformas
  • Apoiar na criação e manutenção de identidades visuais
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipe de marketing e estratégia para desenvolver campanhas


O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência como designer gráfico
  • Domínio de Photoshop, Illustrator e InDesign
  • Boa noção de tipografia, composição e hierarquia visual
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e receber feedback


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com criação para redes sociais
  • Conhecimento em motion ou edição básica de vídeo
  • Interesse ou familiaridade com o agronegócio


Formato de trabalho

  • Vaga 100% remota
  • Horário comercial
  • CLT


Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo e portfólio para . Queremos conhecer seus trabalhos e entender um pouco do seu processo criativo.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About Us :



Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.



Who are You ?



As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace



The Impact you will have:



  • Software Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, and other stakeholders to design, develop, test, and deploy robust Java applications
  • Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while following best practices and coding standards. Also guide less senior engineers towards Test driven development.
  • Technical Analysis: Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues, providing innovative solutions and improvements.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Social Media & Content Strategist (Júnior)
description:
O que você fará?

Como Estrategista de Conteúdo e Growth , você atuará diretamente com a Head de Marketing na execução e estratégia de todos os produtos do portfólio. O foco é traduzir o valor técnico de cada marca em ativos de marketing de alta performance (visual e escrito) para o mercado nacional e internacional.


Suas responsabilidades incluem:

  • Apoiar na pesquisa de nichos e concorrentes para construir cronogramas de conteúdo alinhados aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Criar peças de design gráfico de alta qualidade para LinkedIn, Instagram e Blogs.
  • Editar vídeos curtos (Reels/TikTok/LinkedIn) com foco em alta retenção e clareza de mensagem.
  • Adaptar o tom de voz e a identidade visual para as marcas dentro do portfólio de produto, garantindo consistência e qualidade.
  • Manter-se à frente das tendências de IA, Design e SaaS para trazer ideias de conteúdo e experimentos de crescimento.
  • Gerenciar agendamentos de postagens, interação com a comunidade e acompanhamento de métricas.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês Fluente (escrita e leitura - essencial, pois o conteúdo é voltado para o mercado americano).

title: Analista de SEO | E-commerce
description:
Eleita uma das melhores Agências de Performance Digital em 2024 e 2025 pela ABCOMM (Associação Brasileira do Comércio Eletrônico), a Ecommerce Objetivo é uma aceleradora de E-commerces com foco em Vendas e Performance, com utilização de estratégias digitais para aceleração de lojas virtuais.


Somos especialistas em Performance para E-commerce, atuando com Mídia Paga (tráfego pago), Mídia Orgânica, CRM, SEO, CRO, UX e Growth. Atendemos mais 90 E-commerces, de diversos nichos, sendo referência em resultado e atendimento de qualidade.


Nossa operação é remota, mas temos escritório em Curitiba para os candidatos da cidade. Construímos uma cultura interna de respeito, companheirismo, evolução constante, trabalho em equipe e protagonismo. Todos colaboradores da EO, são de fato escolhidos a dedo, pois essa cultura precisa ser preservada.


Somos formadores de pessoas e profissionais, com plano de carreira robusto em todas as áreas.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Realizar as ações de SEO em E-commerce, com o objetivo de ranquear categorias, produtos e a marca nas primeiras posições do Google, garantindo a execução do nosso Checklist de SEO, mensurando e acompanhando a evolução dos resultados.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Execução do Checklist de SEO da EO, que incluem ações de titles, descripition, arquitetura de páginas, dentre outros
  • Pesquisa de palavras-chave e definição de conteúdo
  • Análise da concorrência e estratégia para o orgânico
  • Registrar as ações e racional no Monday
  • Atendimento aos grupos de WhatsApp dos projetos que esteja inserido


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência na ferramenta Semrush e Google Analytics
  • Capacidade analítica
  • Noção de Excel
  • Domínio das regras gramaticais e a língua portuguesa como um todo


Informações adicionais

  • Home Office e PJ

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: VAGA DEV IA
description:
Vaga aberta para Engenheiro(a) de Software (AI-First & Automação)


A forma como construímos software mudou. Na Nutek Software, nós não buscamos apenas desenvolvedores tradicionais; buscamos orquestradores de Inteligência Artificial.


Somos uma Meta Partner especializada em soluções B2B SaaS de alto impacto. Se você quer atuar na vanguarda da tecnologia, escalando o Chat2Desk e nos ajudando a construir do zero o nosso novo builder de agentes, o AIAgentCore, seu lugar é no nosso time.


O Seu Papel no Nosso Ecossistema:

Aqui, você vai usar ferramentas de IA (Claude Code, Cline.bot, Opencode, Copilot) não apenas como suporte, mas como a principal força de engenharia para escrever, refatorar e otimizar código em velocidade recorde.


Você será responsável por:


Construir do zero arquiteturas com DeepAgents para subagentes de chat e voz no novo AIAgentCore.


Criar e manter automações complexas em nosso cluster n8n (HA), integrando com Typebot e outras APIs.


Atuar diretamente no core dos nossos produtos com Node.js, TypeScript, React + Vite e Bun.


Manter fluxos de CI/CD utilizando GitHub Actions.


O Perfil Que Buscamos:


1 a 2 anos de experiência prática com desenvolvimento de software.


Domínio sólido de Node.js, TypeScript e ecossistema React.


Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados como PostgreSQL (pg_vector é um grande diferencial) e Redis.


Mentalidade AI-First: Uso diário de IDEs orientadas a IA (Antigravity, Replit, VSCode com extensões nativas, Skills) e entendimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol).


Proatividade para atuar em um ambiente 100% remoto, assíncrono e de alta disponibilidade.


Diferenciais: Conhecimento em Bun, Supabase e familiaridade com infraestrutura Docker/Linux (Ubuntu/Debian).


Nossas Condições:


Remuneração: R$ 2.500 a R$ 4.000 / mês (Contratação PJ).


Formato: 100% Remoto.


Como se candidatar:

Quer acelerar sua carreira focando no que o mercado exigirá nos próximos anos? Candidate-se diretamente pelo botão de Candidatura do LinkedIn nesta vaga.


  • (Dica: Certifique-se de que o seu perfil e o link para o seu GitHub estejam atualizados para facilitar nossa triagem!)
